messages:
Kai (design): Quick sync  proposal: make ghost/secondary buttons visually 32px on dense dashboards so they align with condensed table rows. Keep touch target >=44px via invisible padding. Also, toasts are overlapping inline row actions on narrow screens; suggestion: render toasts above toolbar but under modal overlay, non-interactive by default. Thoughts? :eyes:

Maya (frontend): Visual +1. Implementation: keep height:32px and expand hit area with a pseudo-element so layout doesn't shift. Concern about z-index scope, we should use vars.

Ivy (a11y): Invisible hit area is fine if keyboard focus stays on the element and hit area >=44px. Toasts must use role="status" and aria-live="polite" and not steal focus. Interactive toasts need explicit tabindex and close controls.

Noah (devex): Proposed z vars: --z-toolbar:700, --z-toast:800, --z-modal-overlay:1000. Default .toast { pointer-events: none; } .toast--interactive { pointer-events: auto; tabindex:0 } Will add token aliases if we rename compact spacing tokens.

Maya (frontend): I'll open a small PR with CSS snippet, token aliases, and a visual/regression test for table+action stacking. Also tiny copy tweak: change empty-state CTA from "Try again" to "Retry" for console brevity.

Kai (design): Plan: canary to staging, run visual + a11y checks, require one design + one a11y sign-off before merge. Thanks all :rocket:

bot-ci: CI queued for branch/compact-cta-toast (visual-regress, a11y checks)
